err.troppiTentativi: too many attempts, try again later
err.servePasswordAdmin: an admin password is required: set it in Settings -> Admin password
err.serveMotivo: write the reason: it is what explains, six months from now, why this warning no longer sounds
err.serveIndirizzo: a device needs at least an IP or a MAC
err.indirizzoGiaUsato: {indirizzo} already belongs to device '{nome}': edit it instead of adding it
err.bersaglioNonValido: invalid target: hosts, IP addresses or CIDR ranges only
err.configNonOggetto: the configuration must be a YAML object (key: value)
err.configEsiste: config.yaml already exists: edit it from Settings
err.serveSubnet: at least one subnet to monitor is required
err.subnetSingoloIndirizzo: {cidr} is a single address, not a network
err.setupGiaFatto: the configuration already exists: use the Settings page
err.setupSoloLan: the first run is completed from the local network
err.sshTimeout: timeout: the host did not complete the SSH connection (port 22 closed or filtered by a firewall)
stato.raccoltaInCorso: a slow collection is already running
sicurezza.authNone: auth.method: none - the API answers anyone who can reach this address, with no login (reading and writing configuration, devices, Docker)
sicurezza.bypassLan: auth.bypass_lan: true - the login is skipped for every private address: a 'LAN' also includes segmented subnets and VPN clients
sicurezza.nessunaPassword: no admin password set: the first person to open the dashboard can choose it (Settings -> Admin password)
